overview: Netherbian Depths represent the most dangerous section of the Lair.
details: Arcane residue becomes volatile, Netherbian creatures swarm in coordinated patterns, and shadow anomalies distort the tunnels.
hooks: A collapsed chamber reveals ancient Luclin architecture.
Netherbian swarms behave with unnatural coordination.
Transit mages detect unstable arcane pulses deeper within.
Shadow anomalies create temporary rifts in the tunnels.
